scenario_description:
Objective: Use a small concourse lunch-sleeve fitting opening to improve packed-meal organization before a long passenger-service day.
Emerging Need: A broad retail demo becomes a specific short paid card only after report timing, sleeve availability, and funds align.
Decision Context: Saved meal-carry guidance distinguishes the fitting from generic gear browsing and limits any useful commitment to a brief, adjacent, low-cost hold using the current sleeve.
Consequence: Timely organization could add a practical packing benefit without changing the shift plan; ignoring it leaves the ordinary meal setup unchanged, and after release the extra fitting is unavailable.

parameter.title: Lincoln Service passenger report and onboard segment
parameter.description: Report at Union Station for passenger-service coverage with a planned packed-meal break after boarding.

parameter.subject: Tuesday lunch-gear demo table in the south concourse
parameter.body: Tomorrow from 11:30 to 14:30 our south concourse counter will host a small meal-carry gear table. Staff can answer questions about sleeves, dividers, and compact containers. Some walk-up cards may be available if the counter is not full.

parameter.content: I checked while moving the laundry basket: the red insulated lunch sleeve is already in your station backpack. It is empty inside; I do not see any divider insert clipped in it.

parameter.description: Cash set aside for ordinary Union Station food or travel-supply extras tomorrow.

parameter.subject: One 12:10 lunch-sleeve divider-fit card opened for Tuesday
parameter.body: A 12:10 to 12:22 card opened for tomorrow's lunch-sleeve divider-fit station at the south concourse counter beside the passenger crew entrance. The materials card is $8, no organizer-kit purchase is required, and participants should bring their current sleeve. We can hold the card by reply until 17:30 today; after that it goes to the walk-up list.

parameter.subject: 12:10 lunch-sleeve divider-fit card released
parameter.body: The unclaimed 12:10 Tuesday divider-fit card has now been released to the walk-up list. We do not expect additional fitted cards before the midday passenger-report window tomorrow.
